subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'LOBSTER' is written as '121521920518'. How will 'CLIMATE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Position value according to English alphabetic series is written.

So,

 
• 'LOBSTER' is written as '121521920518'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4ed4576130a1ffe4c86282784bcad3c51acca1df536725fdfdea27471cf816c.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'CLIMATE' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddeda0de5ccf3f2d8e2860218287dfb1710e940007ae91f9d0b39cd08b09c68a.png] 

​Hence, "**3129131205**" is the correct answer.

95
